Hello all, I'd like to start a small communication-complexity corner of Mathlib. Step 1 will be a combinatorial rectangle (Set.IsRectangle + characterization + intersection closure). Next pull requests should be, I gueess

  • deterministic protocol tree + D(f)
  • the rectangle property (leaf preimages are rectangles)
  • fooling sets and the log|fooling set| ≤ D(f) bound.

Does the placement Mathlib/Combinatorics/CommunicationComplexity/ sound right, and is anyone willing to be a reviewer for the area? Thanks in advance
